# Working group workflow {#sec-wg-workflow}

```{mermaid}

---
config:
  theme: neutral
---
flowchart TD
I["Select topic (based on priority)"]
I --> J["Identify experts: <br /> 1. QCBS researcher(s) <br /> 2. NGO or governament partners"]
J --> K["Assemble team"]
K --> L["Working Group (QCBS sponsored)"]
L --> M["Decide on scope:<br /> - Questions <br /> - Literature <br /> - Methods <br /> - Assign tasks"]
M --> N["Work happens ⏳"]
N --> O["Reviewers"]
O --> J
O --> P["Publish"]
P --> Q["Receive general feedback"]
Q --> J

```
